English.Char_Desc_45: Distraction-free focus PDF reader for Mac
English.Char_Desc_80: Minimalist PDF reader with frosted-ice backdrop for distraction-free reading.
English.Char_Desc_250: Rime freezes out background screen clutter with a frosted glass focus backdrop, leaving only your document. Features continuous vertical reading, tabs, and instant keyboard bookmarks.
English.Char_Desc_2000: Rime is a minimal, distraction-free PDF reading engine built for researchers, students, and deep-work professionals on macOS. When opened, it isolates the reading plane and applies a soft frosted-ice backdrop over background applications. Built natively in Swift using PDFKit, Rime is extremely lightweight and fast. Free and open source under MIT.
